python3 - <<'PY'
import time
from serial.tools import list_ports
for i in range(4):
    print(f'=== SAMPLE {i} ===')
    ports=list(list_ports.comports())
    for p in sorted(ports,key=lambda x:x.device):
        if p.vid == 0x303A or (p.manufacturer and 'Espressif' in p.manufacturer):
            print(f'DEVICE={p.device} VIDPID={p.vid:04X}:{p.pid:04X} SERIAL={p.serial_number} LOCATION={p.location} MANUFACTURER={p.manufacturer} PRODUCT={p.product}')
    time.sleep(3)
PY
